From Ancient Greek εὔξενος (eúxenos, “friendly to strangers, hospitable”) + English -ite.
In reference to the Black Sea, in Ancient Greek called Πόντος Εὔξεινος (Póntos Eúxeinos, “Hospitable Sea”), which is known for anoxic bottom waters.
